title: A9 - Hall + downstream 13.56 MHz RF-ICP neutralizer investigation
governing_decisions_verbatim: 1. **Primary investigation hypothesis:** Hall accelerator/discharge followed by a **downstream 13.56 MHz RF inductively coupled plasma (ICP) electron source / neutralizer**. This is the Takahashi/Watanabe-type topology: RF is downstream, not an upstream pre-ionizer and not a parallel thrust branch.

2. **Control/fallback:** conventional Hall + heated Xe-fed LaB6 C1 remains the reference/control and fallback until the ICP neutralizer demonstrates electron-current capacity, beam neutralization, power, restart and life.

3. **Old upstream RF/ECR pre-ionizer campaign:** preserve all A5/prereg/evidence artifacts as historical. Do not delete or rewrite them, but do not spend new hardware/procurement effort on them as the primary campaign.
4. **Parallel RF||Hall v2:** keep the branch and A8 as a draft/historical alternative. Do not merge it into the primary line and do not invent missing inputs to make surfaces.
5. **New decision artifact:** create **A9 — Hall + downstream RF-ICP neutralizer investigation**, status `OWNER_AUTHORIZED_INVESTIGATION_HYPOTHESIS_NOT_FLIGHT_BASELINE`.

6. **First decisive hardware comparison:** keep the same H-1 Hall head, feed state, Vd/B settings, stand and metrology; compare the conventional C1 electron source against the downstream ICP electron source using swappable downstream modules and matched service-line/sham controls.

7. **Evidence sequence:** first reproduce the topology on Ar as **engineering-only** evidence; then N2; then O2-bearing atmospheric surrogate; separately use a dedicated atomic-O materials/life programme. No N2+O2 test is called an AO-life test.
8. **Requirement discipline:** 25 mN, <1.5 kW and <40 kg are treated as full-system gates. No discharge-only or RF-generator-only power claim is sufficient.

tension_with_repository_rules.claude_md_rule_8: CLAUDE.md rule 8 ('no new propulsion families until the physics baseline is frozen'). A9 keeps the Hall accelerator family and changes the electron source/neutralizer; it is an explicit owner decision recorded here, not a model-side expansion. No archengine/goldens change is implied.

recorder_consistency_flags_for_owner.issue: v0 dry allocation 'Hall head + magnet 3.0 kg' is below the verified H2-1 magnetic parts alone (MC-1 iron 1.925 kg + copper 1.579 kg = 3.504 kg, H21-24, RP-1, f_NI 2) before body, anode, walls and fasteners.
v0 allocation 'Hall PPU 2.5 kg' is close to the NASA SBIR 2 kg target that row 56 rules out as a CBE; the only mass analog recorded by H2-4 is 6.1 kg (analog PPU).

v0 allocation 'Xe hardware 1.5 kg' is below the H2-7 analog range for the regulator alone (Moog XFC 0.974 kg .. ArianeGroup XRFS 5.9 kg) plus tank and valves (combined analog 4.54-12.77 kg, H2-7 ID-11).
External C1 reference reverses the H2-1/H2-2 preliminary L-CENTRAL choice (H22-OQ-01, H2-1 Q6): H2-1 channel sizing and H2-2 integration need a revision.

>= 50 K margin rule: the verified H2-5 network gives an 11.2 K worst-case BN wall margin and DESIGN_DRIVING inner-coil/pole rows, so the H-1 thermal design is not closed under the new rule (H2-1/H2-5 revision).
The ICP neutralizer has no continuous C1 cathode Xe term, but an ICP source itself needs a gas feed; its gas species and flow must be booked (Xe ledger or atmospheric feed) - not yet assigned.
